RCN-2026-025.summary: Banks and credit unions must give consumers at least 60 days' written notice before increasing fees on deposit accounts. Firms must comply starting March 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-025.reason: The notice applies to banks that offer deposit accounts to consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers consumer checking and savings accounts.

RCN-2026-021.summary: Firms must screen their customer base against sanctions list updates within 24 hours of publication. This requirement becomes effective on December 15, 2026.
RCN-2026-021.reason: The notice applies to all firms subject to sanctions screening obligations, and Brivanta Bank as a retail and small-business bank with deposit accounts and lending products is subject to anti-money laundering sanctions screening requirements.

RCN-2026-022.summary: Deposit-taking institutions must report significant cyber incidents to the Prudential Banking Board within 24 hours and submit a final incident report within 30 days after resolution. Firms must comply starting March 31, 2027.
RCN-2026-022.reason: This rule applies to deposit-taking institutions, and Brivanta Bank offers consumer checking and savings accounts as well as small business deposit accounts, making it a deposit-taking institution within scope.

RCN-2026-023.summary: The Retail Conduct Authority proposes limiting debt collection calls to 7 times in 7 days per debt and requiring firms to honor consumer requests for written-only contact. This is currently a consultation with comments due by January 15, 2027, and proposed effective date of June 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-023.reason: The notice applies to firms that collect consumer debts including debts they originated, and Brivanta Bank collects its own consumer debts.

RCN-2026-024.summary: Payment service providers serving consumers must post a notice in their app and on their website within 1 hour of any outage that prevents customers from making payments. Firms must comply starting February 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-024.reason: The notice applies to payment service providers serving consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers consumer payment services including instant account-to-account payments, checking accounts with overdraft service, and debit and credit cards.
products: instant account-to-account payments in mobile app

RCN-2026-017.summary: Broker-dealers must publish quarterly reports on equity order routing venues and execution quality. Compliance is required from April 1, 2027.

RCN-2026-020.summary: Firms must contact mortgage borrowers within 15 days of a missed payment and offer forbearance options before repossession starting February 1, 2027. Firms that lend or service residential mortgages must comply with these new arrears handling requirements.
RCN-2026-020.reason: The notice applies to firms that lend or service residential mortgages, and Brivanta Bank originates and services residential mortgages.

RCN-2026-019.summary: Firms that send electronic marketing must keep records of when and how each customer consented and must stop sending marketing within 10 days of consent withdrawal. These requirements take effect on January 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-019.reason: The notice applies to any firm that sends electronic marketing to individuals, and Brivanta Bank sends electronic marketing according to its profile.

RCN-2026-018.summary: Firms must offer statements and important notices in large print, braille, or screen-reader friendly formats at no extra cost upon customer request. Compliance is required by February 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-018.reason: The notice applies to all firms that send statements and notices to retail customers, and Brivanta Bank sends statements and notices for its consumer deposit accounts, credit cards, loans, and mortgages.
products: small business loans and deposit accounts

RCN-2026-016.summary: Insurers and insurance intermediaries must complete written suitability assessments before recommending annuities and disclose surrender charges before contract signing. Compliance is required from March 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-016.reason: The notice applies only to insurers and insurance intermediaries that sell or recommend annuities, and Brivanta Bank does not sell or recommend insurance or annuities.

RCN-2026-014.summary: Payment service providers that send instant payments must screen outgoing instant payments for fraud in real time before release and provide customers with a 24/7 fraud reporting mechanism. Firms must comply with these requirements from April 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-014.reason: The notice applies to payment service providers that send instant payments, and Brivanta Bank offers instant account-to-account payments in its mobile app.

RCN-2026-015.summary: Deposit-taking institutions with over $1 billion in assets must run monthly liquidity stress tests including rapid digital deposit outflow scenarios and hold sufficient liquid assets to cover 30 days of net outflows under the most severe scenario. Firms must comply by March 31, 2027.
RCN-2026-015.reason: The notice applies to deposit-taking institutions with more than $1 billion in total assets, and Brivanta Bank is a deposit-taking institution with $18 billion in total assets.
products: instant account-to-account payments in mobile app

RCN-2026-013.summary: Card issuers must display on each monthly statement the repayment time and total interest cost if only minimum payments are made. Compliance is required by May 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-013.reason: The notice applies to card issuers that offer revolving credit cards to consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers credit cards to its retail customers.

RCN-2026-011.summary: Lenders using third-party AI models in consumer credit decisions must maintain an inventory of those models and have their model risk committee review each one annually for performance and fairness. Firms must comply by June 30, 2027.
RCN-2026-011.reason: The notice applies to lenders using third-party AI models to approve, decline or price consumer credit, and Brivanta Bank offers personal loans, residential mortgages, and credit cards which are consumer credit products that may involve such models.

RCN-2026-012.summary: Firms must file suspicious activity reports within 30 calendar days of detection and report SAR volumes and timeliness to the board at least quarterly. Compliance is required starting January 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-012.reason: The notice applies to all firms subject to anti-money laundering obligations, and Brivanta Bank as a retail and small-business bank with deposit accounts, loans, and payment services is subject to AML requirements.
products: small business loans and deposit accounts

RCN-2026-006.summary: Payment service providers must reimburse eligible scam victims within 5 business days and implement payee name-matching warnings before first payments to new recipients. Compliance is required by April 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-006.reason: The notice applies to payment service providers that send instant or same-day account-to-account payments for consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers instant account-to-account payments in its mobile app.

RCN-2026-009.summary: Deposit-taking institutions must create and maintain a register of critical third parties, maintain tested exit plans for each, and review them annually. Firms must comply by March 31, 2027.
RCN-2026-009.reason: The notice applies to deposit-taking institutions that rely on outsourced or cloud services for important business services, and Brivanta Bank is a deposit-taking institution that likely uses third-party technology vendors for its banking systems, mobile app, payment processing, and other operational services.

RCN-2026-007.summary: Firms must retain all complaint records and correspondence for at least 7 years from the final response and provide them to the Authority within 10 business days of a request. These requirements take effect on 2027-01-15.
RCN-2026-007.reason: This notice applies to all firms that handle complaints from retail customers, and Brivanta Bank handles retail consumer and small business customers across all its product lines.

RCN-2026-008.summary: Firms must notify the Financial Data Protection Office within 72 hours of discovering a personal data breach and must notify affected customers without undue delay when the breach creates high risk. Compliance is required starting January 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-008.reason: The notice applies to any firm that holds personal data about retail customers, and Brivanta Bank holds personal data for its consumer and small business customers across all its deposit, lending, and payment products.
products: small business loans and deposit accounts

RCN-2026-010.summary: Firms must record customer vulnerabilities with consent and train customer-facing staff annually to recognize and respond to vulnerability signs. Compliance is required from February 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-010.reason: The notice applies to all firms that serve retail customers, and Brivanta Bank serves retail customers through its consumer banking products, small business accounts, and related services.
products: small business loans and deposit accounts

RCN-2026-005.summary: Banks must identify and verify individuals who own 25% or more of business customers before opening accounts, and refresh this information annually for high-risk business customers. Firms must comply starting January 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-005.reason: The notice applies to banks that open accounts for companies, partnerships and other legal entities, and Brivanta Bank offers small business deposit accounts which fall within this scope.

RCN-2026-003.summary: Deposit-taking institutions with over $1 billion in assets must identify important business services, set impact tolerances, test resilience annually, and obtain board approval. Compliance is required by March 31, 2027.
RCN-2026-003.reason: The notice applies to deposit-taking institutions with more than $1 billion in total assets, and Brivanta Bank is a retail and small-business bank with $18 billion in total assets.

RCN-2026-002.summary: Firms must respond to customer data access requests within 30 days and maintain a log of all requests including dates and outcomes. Compliance is required starting December 1, 2026.
RCN-2026-002.reason: The notice applies to any firm that holds personal data about retail customers, and Brivanta Bank holds personal data for its consumer and small business customers across all its banking products and services.
products: small business loans and deposit accounts

RCN-2026-001.summary: Banks offering overdraft services must show consumers the fee amount before charging and allow them to cancel the transaction, and must send monthly summaries of all overdraft and returned-item fees. Compliance is required by February 1, 2027.
RCN-2026-001.reason: The notice applies to banks that offer deposit accounts with overdraft services to consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers consumer checking and savings accounts with an overdraft service.
products: consumer checking and savings accounts with overdraft service

RCN-2026-004.summary: Firms must acknowledge complaints within 2 business days and provide a final response within 15 business days, replacing the previous 30-day limit. Firms must also analyze complaint root causes quarterly and report findings to senior management, effective January 15, 2027.
RCN-2026-004.reason: This rule applies to all firms that handle complaints from retail customers about banking, lending or payment products, and Brivanta Bank offers all three product categories to retail and small-business customers.
